hypothesis: The immutable review-clean S0 bytes can train on trn22 with the bare LNC2/world4 command, produce a finite model-only checkpoint, and load through the trusted fresh-process public20M evaluator without a Neuron-only regression.
single_causal_change: No science change: this is the first warm native validation of the already prepared S0 candidate, not an optimization arm. Root train.py is a byte-for-byte copy of submissions/candidates/S0/train.py.

candidate_shortlist.idea: Warm native S0 validation on trn22 using an authenticated retained train cache
candidate_shortlist.why_ranked: S0 is the submission safety floor; CPU/G2 exact-argv equivalence is archived, but Neuron training and its own checkpoint loading are not yet proven. This bounded run can expose those failures without being mislabelled a cold replay.
Required later for submission; not interchangeable with this warm-cache job and blocked while the unknown cold footprint lacks safe disk margin.
Separate first research control, staged under another unique label; cannot overlap this S0 job on trn22.
Potential quality upside but dependent on their own native gates and same-host controls; they cannot validate S0.

selection_rationale: A warm S0 native run is the smallest full-chip training and checkpoint-load test of the actual bare-command submission bytes. It is a prerequisite to cold S0 replay, not a substitute for it.
trainium_feasibility: LNC2/world4, seed 42, 1800-second in-file budget, exact bare train.py argv, known legacy guard, and the six historically authenticated trn22 116188 training-cache paths. The six paths require new read-only live existence and anchored-inventory checks; cache hits are not guaranteed for S0. Require 8,833,482,752 free bytes before dispatch: the unchanged 6.5-GiB operational floor plus the historical 1,854,160,896-byte dense cold-footprint loss. The current host may be below this threshold; no gate may be lowered.
cheapest_falsifier: Reject before dispatch if the exact S0/prepare/launcher hashes, G1 trn22, S0 bare G2, cache identities, clean unique checkout, host quiescence, or 8,833,482,752-byte free-space projection fails. On native run, reject a crash, nonfinite loss/checkpoint, missing five step boundaries, failed timing/host postflight, over-budget summary, causality failure, or fresh-process evaluation failure.
